list: The official 55 trophies, as Exophase and PSNProfiles listed them on 2026-11-18 (the two agreeing on every name, description and grade). Rockstar had not published an official list at launch; trophy triggers below are reported by the cited guides, not confirmed by Rockstar.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours — there is no separate task. PowerPyx rates the full journey at roughly 200 hours and 4/10 difficulty: about 60–80 hours of story, then around 100 hours of post-story cleanup for 100% completion, then the stranger strands and stragglers. Work the roadmap in order (story first, 100% checklist second, cleanup last) and this is the last trophy you earn.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It pops as the mission ends, so no preparation is needed — just play the story from the start.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish every mission in Chapter 1. While you are in Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation when it is offered — it may be needed for Positive Mental Attitude, the one possibly missable trophy — and keep a manual save from early in the chapter.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish every mission in Chapter 2. Chapter 2 is also where the Scooter Bros app opens up (see On the Spot) and where the Breakfast Run mission sits, so pick up side content as it appears rather than leaving it all for after the story.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish every mission in Chapter 3. The Cartel Heist mission in this chapter pops its own trophy (Break the Bank), and the Snap Gun you pick up from Yasmani here is what makes Sneakthief possible later.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish every mission in Chapter 4. This chapter holds three mission trophies of its own (Family Matters, DWNFALL, Hi-Jacked) and the optional mission that unlocks bank-vault robberies for Maximum Withdrawal — take the optional mission when it appears.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish the final mission in Chapter 5 and the credits roll. Note on Gamerscore: guide sites disagree on this one's Xbox value — Output Lag and GTA Zone report 50G while ofzenandcomputing reports 100G — so treat the G value as reported, not official. Nothing else is required; the story alone earns it.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete the Breakfast Run mission in Chapter 2. It is a main-story mission, so it pops as you play through the chapter — no side requirement.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. A main-story heist mission — play the chapter through and it pops on completion.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete the Child's Play mission in Chapter 4. Main story only — finish the mission and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete the Headliners mission in Chapter 4. Play the chapter's main missions in order and it pops when Headliners ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete the VCIA Takedown mission in Chapter 4. This is the story's airport mission — note the location, because the free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can also takes place at VCIA later.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. A late-story mission — keep playing the main path and it pops on completion.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The big post-story grind, worth a gold trophy. Once the story ends, the 100% checklist appears at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and everything you did earlier already counts toward it. PowerPyx reports the checklist covers roughly 60% of true completion, with these reported requirements: story complete, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles discovered, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, all 8 bank vaults, 39 illegal operations, all 42 Top Fun races, 15 of 18 meditation spots, 3 card sets, and 8 Strangers & Freaks strands. Chip away at it in the post-story phase of the roadmap — scanning vehicles and studying animals as you travel saves hours.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts are the driving tricks the game counts as you play — jumps, near misses, air time and the like. There are 397 stunt spots in total and 300 count toward 100% completion, so this silver at 250 comes naturally on the way there. The fastest route is to work the stunt jumps deliberately in free roam between missions rather than hunting them all after the story; a fast car and the open highways around Leonida make the counter climb quickly.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample the game's side activities: try each of the 9 activity types once and the trophy pops. The reported types are the game's activity menu — races, shooting ranges, fishing, arcade games, bowling, drone races, meditation, hunting and similar. You do not need to win or finish anything, just try each one once, so knock this out early in free roam and let the deeper trophies (The Shootist, Top Fun, Baited My Tackle) build on it.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit all 12 shooting ranges and earn a gold medal in every one of their 42 challenges. This is a skill trophy, not a grind: learn each range's weapon and target pattern, and replay a challenge until the gold threshold clears. Ammu-Nation ranges are the reported venues; do a few ranges between story chapters so the shooting practice also helps the missions.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.target: Win at all 14 locations (42 races total)
trophies.guide: Top Fun runs drone races at 14 locations across Leonida — win at least one race at every location. All 42 races count toward 100% completion, so winning them all kills two birds. Drone handling is its own skill: cut corners through the gates, learn each course's line, and retry a location until the win lands.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race only counts once, so you need 20 distinct events out of the 40 on offer. Street races, off-road and the rest all count; pick the vehicle class you drive best, learn the route on a first attempt, then win it on the retry. Races also feed the stunt and driving practice that helps everywhere else.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.target: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge
trophies.guide: Find Cal and beat him in a fishing challenge. Fishing is a timing activity — hook, reel and keep the tension in the safe zone — and Cal is the named rival angler. Challenge him when fishing spots open up in free roam; losing costs nothing but the attempt, so retry until you out-fish him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Walk up to any arcade cabinet and finish one full game. You only need to complete it, not beat a high score, so pick the shortest cabinet you find. Arcade cabinets are scattered through Vice City's entertainment spots — one quick game and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand — the trophy pops when his final mission is complete. Character strands stay open after the story ends, so if you miss Andy during the campaign, pick his strand up in the post-story cleanup phase of the roadmap.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand — the trophy pops when his final mission is complete. Like the other character finales, the strand stays available after the story, so it can be done in the post-story cleanup if you did not finish it during the campaign.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.target: Billy's final mission (Thrillbilly Mudclub, Kelly County)
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County — the trophy pops on his final mission. The mudclub is the rural meetup spot, so expect off-road driving and mud-racing flavor on the way there; the strand stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Not every stranger encounter counts — only full strands do — so follow each stranger's missions through to their end rather than doing one-offs. The character finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) overlap with this count, so finishing those strands puts you most of the way there; the rest come from stranger markers that appear as you explore.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand — the trophy pops when his final mission is complete. Randy's strand stays open after the story, so it fits the post-story cleanup phase if you have not finished it by the finale.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand — the trophy pops when his final mission is complete. Like the other character finales it stays open after the story, so mop it up in cleanup if needed.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the only trophy with a missable warning. Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations in Leonida. Guides report the Chapter 1 balcony meditation may be required for the count, and it is unconfirmed whether it can be done later — so do it the first time it is offered in Chapter 1, and keep a manual save from early Chapter 1 as insurance. The other spots are scattered viewpoints and quiet places; 15 of the 18 spots also count toward 100% completion, so this folds into the post-story checklist once the Chapter 1 spot is safe.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.target: Hunt a unique animal for Bret (Jason only)
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — reported as a Jason-only hunt. The exact animal is still unconfirmed in the guides at launch, so treat the target as unconfirmed: follow Bret's strand, take the hunt when it is offered, and check the in-game prompt for which animal it names. Hunting also feeds the 100-of-255 animals-studied count for 100% completion, so study animals with the camera as you travel.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible cards are hidden around Leonida in 18 sets — complete any 3 sets for this silver. Cards sit in shops, interiors and out-of-the-way spots; grab them as you pass through areas during the story instead of sweeping the whole map at the end. Finishing sets also feeds the 100% checklist, so keep collecting past the third set.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK is the in-game phone app for photographing points of interest — WAiNK It at 100 locations. Reported breakdown: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities and 23 Sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. Point the phone at a marked spot, snap it, and the counter climbs; it is a natural companion to exploring for The Goodtime State, since every new area holds new WAiNK spots.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges are the game's checklist of small feats — driving, combat, exploration and more — with 80 in total. Complete any 50 for this bronze; 70 count toward 100% completion. Many complete themselves while you chase other trophies, so check the challenge list (Progress menu) now and then and deliberately clear the easy ones — stunts, races and collectibles overlap heavily.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.target: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. The reliable setup: commit crimes together until the fourth star appears, then break line of sight — duck into the countryside, switch cars, or hide until the search cone fades. Do it with Lucia or Jason as your partner in free roam; failing just means trying again, so do not attempt it mid-mission.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.target: Rob 3 shops in a row, partner present, wanted level kept
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops back-to-back — and keep your wanted level the whole way, which is the trick: the level must not drop between robberies. Plan a route with three close shops, rob fast, move immediately to the next, and stay in the wanted state rather than hiding. A getaway car parked nearby and a quick driver make the chain much easier.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK as you meet them — each new model adds to the count. Leonida holds 277 vehicles and 200 count toward 100% completion, so keep scanning everything you pass: traffic, parked cars, boats and aircraft all count. Make scanning a habit from the first hour and this trophy lands long before the 200 mark.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-mo aiming mode (L3+R3 while aiming). Trigger it in a firefight with at least five enemies in front of you and take down five before the focus ends. The easiest setup is a busy shootout with grouped enemies — a gang hideout or a wanted-level shootout — where targets are plentiful and close together. If you only get three or four, retry: the trophy needs all five in a single use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.target: Steal a jet at VCIA, fly ~1 km
trophies.guide: Head to Vice City International Airport (VCIA), steal a jet at gates E3/E4, and fly roughly a kilometre — an unscheduled departure, no ticket needed. Expect a wanted level the moment you are on the tarmac, so get in, throttle up and climb fast; once you are a kilometre out the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.target: Steal a Rhino tank (Mile Zero Air Station)
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank from the Mile Zero Air Station. Military bases mean heavy resistance — go in fast, in a sturdy vehicle, grab the Rhino and drive it out rather than fighting the whole base. The trophy's own description is the hint: it is hot in those Rhinos, so expect heat the moment you climb in.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.target: Undetected jewelry-store robbery (Snap Gun, Yasmani, Ch. 3)
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The reported tool is the Snap Gun, picked up from Yasmani in Chapter 3 — it lets you crack cases quietly. Case the store first, move when the clerk and cameras are not on you, grab the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so reload and try a quieter approach.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.target: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape (8 vaults total)
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape — there are 8 vaults in total. Vault robberies unlock through an optional mission in Chapter 4, so take that mission when it appears or the vaults never open to you. Each vault is a heist-style job with an escape: plan the getaway before you go in, and bank the first five for the silver, then the rest for 100% completion.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.target: Rob an armored truck and escape
trophies.guide: A nod to the classic GTA armored-truck robbery: intercept an armored truck, crack it open and escape with the cash. Trucks run set routes through Vice City — tail one, stop it (sticky bombs or a hard ram work), grab the money and lose the wanted level. One clean robbery and escape is all it takes.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.target: Explore all of Leonida (clear the map fog)
trophies.guide: Explore every corner of Leonida until the map fog is gone. The fastest reported method is a plane: fly a grid over the state and the fog clears as you pass. Do it after the story, when the whole map is open, and combine it with WAiNK photography and card hunting — every new area holds spots for You WAiNKer! and Don't Touch My Deck.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.target: Rob one illegal op per gang (9 gangs; 39 ops for 100%)
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang is enough for the trophy, while 39 operations count toward 100% completion. Illegal ops are the gangs' side businesses marked on the map; hitting one angers its gang, so go in prepared and get out fast. Spread the robberies across the map as you explore and the trophy lands on the ninth gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.target: Cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach
trophies.guide: TRIGGER UNCONFIRMED — the guides at launch agree on the trophy's name and description but not on the exact trigger. The description says it plainly: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or venue overlooking Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view; if it does not pop, try the beachfront bars at different times of day. This guide will not invent a precise spot until a source pins it down.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.target: Smash out of a vehicle showroom
trophies.guide: TRIGGER UNCONFIRMED — the exact showroom and setup are not yet pinned down by the guides. The description is the plan: get inside a vehicle showroom, then smash your way out through the glass in classic GTA style — drive a car straight through the front window and out. Try the main dealership showrooms in Vice City; this guide will not invent a specific address until a source confirms one.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Head to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Port Gellhorn. The reported trigger is robbing the bowling alley's illegal operation — the follow-through the description hints at. Treat the alley like any other illegal op: go in, take it, and get out; the trophy pops on completion.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.target: Max Strength for BOTH Jason and Lucia
trophies.guide: Raise Strength to maximum for both Jason and Lucia — the partnership the description hints at. Strength grows through physical activity (gym work, melee, heavy lifting); switch between the two characters and train each in turn. It is a slow burn, so start early and top both stats up during the post-story phase.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The Criminal Profile tracks your choices — 500 actions and the trophy pops. There is no single trick: play the game the GTA way (crime, chaos, side content) and the count climbs on its own across the story and free roam. Check the profile in the Progress menu to see how far along you are; by the time the 100% checklist is done, this should be close.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: TRIGGER UNCONFIRMED — the guides agree only on the hint: second time's the charm. The likeliest reading is succeeding at something on the second attempt after failing the first — a race, a challenge, a mission retry. Do not force it; play normally, retry what you fail, and this should pop on its own. This guide will not invent a specific event until a source confirms one.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: TRIGGER UNCONFIRMED — the description ('What the hell just happened?') points at one of Leonida's strange encounters or easter eggs, but no guide has pinned down which one at launch. Explore the odd corners of the map — the swamps, the Keys, the backroads at night — and keep an eye out for the unexpected. This guide will not invent a location until a source confirms it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: TRIGGER UNCONFIRMED in detail — the description is the method: knock someone over with a melee drive-by, i.e. a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a pedestrian and swing a melee weapon from the car; the reported reading is a bowling-style knockdown, hence Ten Pin. Try it in a quiet street where you will not pick up a big wanted level, and expect to retry until the hit registers.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Heists and robberies pay out in Marked Bills, which are no good until laundered. Use your contacts to launder them — the total is cumulative, so every laundered dollar counts toward $250,000. Keep laundering as you earn through the story and the vault, truck and shop robberies; the counter climbs steadily and the trophy lands well before the end of the 100% grind.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — cumulative, so every purchase counts: clothes, weapons, ammo, food, vehicle mods. You will spend much of this naturally through the story; if you are short near the end, top it up with ammo and weapon purchases, which are always useful. Garages are properties, not shop spending, so they count toward Little Boxes instead.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties for sale across Leonida — about $160,000 in total, so save up or launder marked bills first. Garages that come with the story do not count; only the 8 purchasable ones do. They double as vehicle storage for the Scooter Bros registrations (On the Spot), so buy them before you start registering cars in bulk.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the in-game service run by Moses, opening in Chapter 2. You need garage space for the vehicles you register, so buy garages (Little Boxes) first, then register a spread of cars you already own or find. Ten registrations and the trophy pops.

roadmap.title: Story — Chapters 1 to 5
roadmap.text: Play the main story straight through, five chapters. Take every optional mission when it appears (Chapter 4's unlocks bank-vault robberies). Scan vehicles with WAiNK and study animals as you travel. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation when offered — it may be required for Positive Mental Attitude — and keep a manual save from early Chapter 1. No difficulty trophies, no mission replay, no New Game+, so play at your own pace; cheats disable trophies and saving, and only unlock after the story.

roadmap.title: Post-story 100% checklist
roadmap.text: After the credits, the 100% checklist opens at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion (earlier progress already counts). Work it in order: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, 8 bank vaults, 39 illegal operations, 42 Top Fun races, 15 of 18 meditation spots, 3 card sets, 8 stranger strands. This stage earns A Long Road (gold) and most silvers and bronzes along the way.

roadmap.title: Strangers, finales and cleanup
roadmap.text: Finish the stranger strands and character finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) — they stay open after the story. Then mop up the one-offs: the VCIA jet, the Rhino tank, the bowling alley, the showroom smash, the Ocean Beach cocktail, and any unconfirmed-trigger trophies once guides pin them down. The platinum pops with the last trophy.

notes: All 55 trophies are single-player — there are no online trophies.
No difficulty trophies: play on any difficulty.
No mission replay and no New Game+. There are 15 manual save slots plus autosave — save at the start of each chapter.
Cheats disable trophies and saving. The 61 cheats unlock only after the story is complete.
One possibly missable trophy: Positive Mental Attitude — do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation and keep a Chapter 1 save.

Five trophies have unconfirmed triggers at launch (In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin) — their guides say so plainly instead of inventing a trigger. Fair Game's exact animal is also unconfirmed.
Gamerscore values are reported by guide sites, not official, and sites disagree on one: 'You Gotta Know When to Get Off' is reported as 50G by Output Lag and GTA Zone and 100G by ofzenandcomputing.
Trophy names, descriptions and grades are as Exophase and PSNProfiles listed them on 2026-11-18. Rockstar had not published an official trophy list at launch.
